visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: The Modulo-9 Formula
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Nested loops add the digits again and again. Use the closed form: the digital root of n is 1 + (n - 1) % 9 for n greater than 0. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: A number and its digit sum leave the same remainder when divided by 9, so repeating the digit sum ends at the remainder mod 9 (with 9 instead of 0). The formula needs no loops.
